contrast: root-level selected proxy gain minus mean paired interactive deployment gain
no_update: retain the incumbent and assign zero proxy and deployment gain
rng: Python random.Random seeded by the integer represented by bootstrap_seed_sha256
method: whole-root bootstrap with one unstandardized max-absolute-deviation radius across the four paired gaps
coverage_scope: approximate simultaneous 95% family conditional on the frozen 50-root cohort; separate from the original 24-estimate family and other outcome-aware diagnostics
interpretation_limit: The proxy-to-interactive gap does not identify causal proxy bias; it may reflect winner selection, finite proxy-sample noise, and replay-versus-interactive environment differences.
